items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: I called him John. I didn’t call him Dizzy in the later years.

ctx.x: And it was deep, deep, deep stuff. There were three Dizzy Gillespies. There was Dizzy the screwball that everybody knows. Then there was John Gillespie, who was the very spiritual man. I called him John. I didn’t call him Dizzy in the later years. And then there was the very serious musician. He would be a nut until he put his horn up and then this look would come over him and he was serious as a heart attack.
